question: 2022 年各地区的销售额分别是多少？
sql:
SELECT c.region AS region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS gmv
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2022-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY c.region
